# Three.js r186 / 0.186.0

Unmodified selected files from the official `three@0.186.0` npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.186.0.tgz

Upstream release: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/releases/tag/r186
License: MIT; see `LICENSE`.

The module entry points and their transitive dependencies are copied by
`node scripts/vendor-three.mjs /path/to/extracted/package`. The script checks the
package version and vendors only the modules used by Snake. No runtime CDN or
package installation is required. Do not replace these files with a moving
unversioned build.
